new_defect_types.name: inverted_relief / negative-space error
new_defect_types.description: An impression, mould, dent or engraving is rendered as a raised positive shape (or vice versa): a hand imprint that bulges up as a fabric hand, a footprint that is a raised foot.
examples: phi545/fibo2_dev: hand print is a convex fabric hand with palm creases sitting in a pit
new_defect_types.why_not_v2: A12 talks about rigid shape and gravity; nothing asks whether a trace is concave or convex. VLMs see "a hand shape" and pass it.

new_defect_types.name: trace_cause_mismatch
new_defect_types.description: A trace does not match the thing that made it: wiped area not under the wiper, imprint with wrong digit count or mirrored copies, shadows starting in mid-air instead of at the object, rain drops on a dashboard indoors.
examples: phi420/ideogram4_nf4: clean dome-shaped area sits below wipers that rest in the upper glass
phi545/flux3_klein_base: one palm with 5 finger grooves up and 5 down
orig189/gemini_3_1_flash_image: three shadows fan out from one point in the sand
phi420/flux3_klein: rain drops beaded on the interior dashboard
new_defect_types.why_not_v2: A12 says "cause produces effect" but only with examples of missing effects (no wet ground); it does not ask whether a present effect matches its cause in location, count and geometry.

new_defect_types.name: required_text_occluded
new_defect_types.description: A requested text string is partly hidden behind a foreground subject, so letters are missing although rendered correctly.
examples: orig540/gpt_image_2: shoulder covers "t" of through and "e" of expectation
orig540/gpt_image_2_quality_high: woman's head covers "e" of expectation
new_defect_types.why_not_v2: A02 checks glyphs, A17 only frame edges, B04 equality of legible text; occlusion falls between them.

new_defect_types.name: inconsistent_implied_altitude
new_defect_types.description: Aerial or satellite views mix cues from different heights: planetary horizon curvature with block-level detail, or fisheye tilt without a lens reason.
examples: phi68/flux3_klein_base: orbital curvature with ships readable as from ~2 km
new_defect_types.why_not_v2: A11 covers convergence and order, A20 relative sizes; neither covers camera-height consistency.

rubric_issues.problem: "Cause produces effect" lists missing effects only; judges do not check that a present effect matches its cause in position, count, direction, or the side of a barrier it is on.
examples: phi420/fibo2_dev rain on the interior dashboard
rubric_issues.proposed_fix: Add sub-check: "Every trace (shadow, imprint, wiped area, splash, wake) starts at its cause, has the cause's shape and count, and lies on the physically reachable side of glass/roofs. Sun shadows are parallel."

rubric_issues.problem: The prompt says "animation scene" but 6 of 12 models made photoreal composites. v2 says the requested style decides the mode, but gives no rule on whether a photoreal output of an animation request is judged photographic (and B05 flagged) or non_photographic.
rubric_issues.proposed_fix: State: mode for Layer A follows what is rendered; a mismatch with the requested medium is recorded once under B05 (moderate when the whole image is in the wrong medium).

rubric_issues.problem: Solid figures merging into fluids (a statue whose robe becomes a water spout) can be a defect or a deliberate VFX look.
rubric_issues.proposed_fix: Count it as A08 unless the prompt asks for a transformation or dissolve; cap at moderate when the effect is clearly stylised.

rubric_issues.criterion: B01 vs B02 for symbol variants
rubric_issues.problem: A requested symbol rendered as a related symbol (eighth note -> beamed pair or sixteenths) does not fit "count" or "object kind" cleanly.
rubric_issues.proposed_fix: Wrong symbol variant = B02; a malformed glyph that is no valid symbol = A10.

rubric_issues.problem: Dashcam timestamps, film borders and paper edges come with the requested genre ("dashcam footage", "retro film"), but the A16 wording would flag them.
rubric_issues.proposed_fix: Exclude overlays implied by the requested medium from A16; still check their text under A02.

false_positive_traps.description: Overlays that the prompt's genre implies (dashcam OSD, aged photo border, film scratches/dust) are not A16 or A22.
Floating 3D road shields or labels in a "Google Earth style" render follow the requested UI style; they are not pseudo-text or overlays.
A requested real landmark (Statue of Liberty, Giza pyramids, Manhattan skyline) should not be counted as a C01 risk the same way as an unrequested brand.
Extra but scene-serving elements (camel rider in pyramids, glass UI cards in a glassmorphism image, distant camels) should not be B07.
Hand placement offset from imprint (hand lifted away after pressing) is correct for "just releases pressure"; do not flag missing contact.
Motion-blurred or ghosted wiper blades are requested (mid-swipe) and are not A07 duplicates.
